Quick reference

Choose notes and press Start. After four count-in clicks, play the displayed note on the indicated string, one location per click. Each note travels across the selected strings, low to high. FretFlash keeps time; it does not listen or show answer frets.

BPM sets clicks per minute. Frets includes both limits; 0 means open string. Strings with no matching note in that range are skipped.

Targets: One per string gives one click per available string; choose any matching location within the range. All in range gives a click for every matching location: lowest fret first, then the next string.

Notes: each selected spelling appears once per round, in shuffled order. C# and Db are separate prompts, even though they sound the same. Notes with no available location are omitted.

Tuning & playback controls

Strings selects which strings to practice. Tuning sets their open notes. Custom tuning takes 6 or 7 space-separated notes, low to high, using # or b for accidentals. Changing tuning selects all strings again.

Restart while paused and Repeat after finishing replay the same round. Shuffle makes a new order. Change BPM while paused or finished without losing the round. Stop returns to setup.

Keyboard: outside controls, Space starts, pauses or resumes; after finishing it shuffles. Escape closes an editor first, otherwise exits the drill.
